## Workflow

GET <parent-path>/{parent_id}/export processes up to 1000 children in ID order. The workflow is gzip_export. Larger results return 413. CSV apps also accept POST <parent-path>/{parent_id}/import with text/csv and 1 to 20 rows. Headers must match custom child fields. \N means null. CSV import commits once or rolls back all rows.
